sentences.text: Roseburia hominis is a gut microbial taxon reported to decrease consistently in metabolic disorders and to increase after dietary interventions across five human cohorts.

In that work, strain-level genetic variation in Roseburia hominis distinguished metabolic disorder status, and ohyA, encoding an oleate hydratase, was prioritised as a candidate functional determinant.
In a randomized crossover trial of two Mediterranean diets in Parkinson's disease, both interventions increased the relative abundance of Roseburia hominis.
A systematic review of 18 studies reported reduced beneficial bacteria, such as Faecalibacterium prausnitzii and Roseburia hominis, in patients with Alzheimer's disease compared with controls.
